Auth.tagline: A little help to care better.
Auth.loginDescription: Keep track of the moments that matter.
Auth.registerDescription: Start with the basics. You can adjust everything later.

Profile.title: You're all set
Profile.description: Your account is connected and ready.
Profile.sessionInvalid: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

Onboarding.dateHint: Choose the first day of the period. You can update it later.
Onboarding.privacy: Your information stays private and is only used to create cycle reminders.
Onboarding.genericError: We couldn't load your setup. Please try again.
Onboarding.welcomeTitle: Be there at the right time
Onboarding.welcomeDescription: bebo helps you keep track of your partner's cycle and reminds you before the next period may begin.
Onboarding.welcomeBenefitCycleHint: See the next estimated period date without having to remember it yourself.
Onboarding.welcomeBenefitReminderHint: Get a Telegram message before the estimated period begins.
Onboarding.welcomeBenefitCareHint: A small reminder can help you be more thoughtful and supportive.
Onboarding.cycleDescription: Add the first day of the most recent period. bebo will use this to estimate the next cycle.
Onboarding.defaultCycleLengthHint: Not sure? Keep 28 days. bebo will learn from new cycle records over time.
Onboarding.cycleSaveError: We couldn't save the cycle information.
Onboarding.reminderDescription: Set how early and what time bebo should send a private reminder.
Onboarding.timezoneHint: This controls the local time when your reminder is sent.
Onboarding.previewMessage: {count, plural, =0 {The next period may begin today.} one {The next period may begin tomorrow.} other {The next period may begin in # days.}}
Onboarding.reminderSaveError: We couldn't save the reminder settings.
Onboarding.telegramDescription: Connect Telegram so bebo can send the reminder directly to you.
Onboarding.telegramPrivacy: Messages are sent only to your connected Telegram account. Your partner will not receive them.
Onboarding.skipHint: You can continue without Telegram, but bebo won't be able to send reminders until you connect it later.
Onboarding.completeDescription: bebo is ready to help you remember the moments when a little extra care may matter.

Dashboard.description: A simple view of your partner's next estimated cycle.
Dashboard.daysUntil: {count, plural, =0 {Expected today} one {# day remaining} other {# days remaining}}
Dashboard.daysPast: {count, plural, one {Estimate passed # day ago} other {Estimate passed # days ago}}
Dashboard.basedOnHistory: {count, plural, one {Based on # recent cycle} other {Based on # recent cycles}}
Dashboard.addPeriodDescription: Choose the first day of the period.
Dashboard.loadError: We couldn't load your cycle data.
Dashboard.editPeriodDescription: Update the first day of this period.
Dashboard.deleteConfirmDescription: This date will be removed and your cycle prediction will be recalculated. This action cannot be undone.

Notifications.title: Notification history
Notifications.description: Review cycle reminders sent privately through Telegram.
Notifications.emptyDescription: Sent and failed cycle reminders will appear here after the first scheduled reminder.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Adjust how cycle predictions and reminders work.
Settings.defaultCycleLengthHint: Used until enough cycle history is available.
Settings.reminderDaysHint: Choose how many days before the expected period.
Settings.timezoneHint: Use an IANA time zone such as Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
Settings.changesHint: Changes apply to the next prediction and reminder.
Settings.notificationHistoryHint: View sent, failed, and retried cycle reminders.
